thesis: A short work-trip vlog combines enjoyment, movement and a brief family-time reminder.
summary: Bloom travels to Venice for a LinkedIn speaking event, jokes with a videographer, eats local food, visits a gym and runs through the city. A short event exchange repeats his finite-time-with-children theme. Most content is travel footage, banter and tasting reactions rather than a new business or wealth framework.

insights.title: Use a run to explore a place
insights.explanation: He describes seeing different parts of Venice by varying his running route; this is a personal travel preference.
